en.title: Leave, Maternity and Basic Workplace Rights
en.directAnswer: Bangladesh labour law provides rights on matters such as leave, working conditions and maternity benefits for workers who fall within the relevant law. The exact amount of leave, eligibility and procedure depend on current amended sections and the worker’s status. Do not rely on an old HR blog.

atAGlance.whoFor: A worker wants an overview of leave and basic statutory rights.
atAGlance.legalBasis: Bangladesh Labour Act, 2006; Bangladesh Labour (Amendment) Act, 2026; EPZ Labour Act where applicable.
atAGlance.mainRule: Every numeric entitlement in the final article must cite the current amended section.
atAGlance.updateStatus: LAW UPDATED: all numbers must be checked against the 2026 amended text immediately before publication.

en.lawMeaning: Every numeric entitlement in the final article must cite the current amended section. This page gives a general route. A person’s exact rights can change because of facts, documents, deadlines, legal status, court orders or later amendments.
steps: Identify whether the Labour Act or EPZ Act applies.
Check length of service and worker category.
For maternity benefit, keep required medical/employment records.
evidence: Appointment letter; attendance; leave ledger; HR policy; medical documents; salary records.
en.simpleExample: A worker reads an old article saying one number of maternity days. Justor should instead show the current amended section and verification date.
commonMistakes: Common mistakes: Publishing old leave numbers.
Common mistakes: treating company policy as the law.
Common mistakes: assuming every worker has identical coverage..

whatIf.question: What if company policy gives more than the law?
whatIf.answer: The more generous lawful policy may still apply.

whatIf.question: What if the employer refuses statutory leave?
whatIf.answer: Keep the refusal and seek the correct remedy.

whatIf.question: What if you work in an EPZ?

en.specialistTrigger: Maternity dismissal; health/safety issue; disputed worker classification; EPZ.
